cross_system_requirements.name: Canonical ownership
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Each production implementation has exactly one canonical repository
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: No active competing implementation exists for the same canonical component

cross_system_requirements.name: Versioned interfaces
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Cross-component interfaces and binary formats are versioned and testable
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Compatibility and rejection behavior are covered by tests

cross_system_requirements.name: Exact-SHA evidence
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Verification refers to exact tested commit SHA
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Evidence records workflow run, job, step, exit code and relevant log or artifact

cross_system_requirements.name: Fail-closed validation
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Malformed input, missing authority and unsupported versions fail explicitly

cross_system_requirements.name: Status integrity
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Implementation and verification are not inferred from file presence or PR merge state
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: VERIFIED requires defined technical gates and exact-SHA evidence

cross_system_requirements.name: Dependency integrity
cross_system_requirements.requirement: Dependencies are explicit and conflicts are tracked
cross_system_requirements.acceptance: Integration tests cover declared cross-component contracts

audit_requirements: Confirm repository names, canonical paths, default branches and current SHAs
Compare catalog entries with current default-branch source
Collect public APIs, modules, types, commands, formats and tests
Link each specification to normative document and version
Link each implemented function to source paths and tests
Record exact SHA and CI Run-to-Job-to-Step evidence
Resolve duplicate ownership, specification conflicts and missing dependencies
Do not promote AUDIT_REQUIRED or PROPOSED to VERIFIED without evidence
For each system and function, record Soll separately from Ist; keep unassessed Ist explicit
Record source paths, test references and exact commit SHA for every Ist claim
Set delta to MATCH only when acceptance criteria are demonstrated by source and tests
Set VERIFIED only with exact-SHA Run-to-Job-to-Step evidence and passing exit status
Record gaps, conflicts and blockers instead of silently upgrading status
Store repository inventory snapshots with default branch, exact commit SHA and canonical source/test/spec paths
Distinguish path presence from behavior-level implementation and exact-SHA verification
Run the machine-readable catalog validator in CI on every pull request touching the catalog or validator
Bind each function to source and test references before evaluating its Soll/Ist delta
Bind CI run, job, step, exit code and log/artifact URL to the same tested commit SHA before VERIFIED

state_model.description: Machine-readable Soll/Ist comparison. Soll is the target defined by this catalog; Ist is only populated from inspected source and reproducible evidence. Unknown is never treated as absent or passing.
state_model.rule: Do not infer IST from the existing catalog status, file presence, PR state, or unverified claims.

repository_inventory.inventory_method: GitHub REST default-branch commit metadata plus recursive git tree inventory
repository_inventory.inventory_scope: Six repositories support seven catalog systems; ATC-VM and ATC-Algorithm are canonical subpaths in a-townchain
limitations: Tree presence establishes repository/path existence only; it does not prove correctness, completeness, build success, or runtime behavior.
No function is promoted to IMPLEMENTED or VERIFIED by this inventory.
Per-repository CI run/job/step/exit/log evidence has not yet been bound to these exact source SHAs.
